mathematics.assertion_tested: For the 81 recorded initializer configurations, quantized single-coin reference keys and displayed threshold brackets agree with independent high-precision geometry, principal rounds upward within the intended allocation, and raw funding is the required ceiling.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: SDK integers with Q128/Q64 fixed point; independent Python Decimal at 110 and 160 significant digits.
mathematics.conventions: n is selected-token count; GRID=2^32; full-range sentinel=2^64-1; normalized token precision=18; single-coin depeg p in [0,1].

bounds.baskets: all three pairs of the current deployment plus one basket at each size 3–8; extra tokens synthetic

non_claims: Not a proof for every allocation, basket, trade size or trajectory.
Does not add supported Arc assets or deploy/publish any strategy.
Does not prove global solver liveness, economic safety during a depeg, or all supporting-price claims.
